summary: No A4 violation found. Every verifier and every party that supplies a revert root hash at delivery supplies the before-hash. (1) Dave v3.0.0-alpha.7 CartesiStateTransition.transitionState passes machineState as the revert root hash to SendCmioResponse.sendCmioResponse at every input-window opening ((counter & INPUT_MASK)==0). Tournament.winLeafMatch passes divergence.agreeState, which Match._requireAgreeState authenticates as leaf divergencePosition-1, or as initialHash at position 0. An inner tournament's initialHash is the outer agree hash, and its startCycle is toCycle(divergencePosition). So machineState is the canonical hash at the window start. The geometry 38+54=92=48+20+24 matches the masks. (2) Empty slot: DaveConsensus.provideMerkleRootOfInput returns 0 at or past _inputIndexUpperBound. CartesiStateTransition then skips delivery and runs the step alone, and it rejects input bytes that come with a zero root (InputBytesWithoutInput). (3) Oversized input: InputBox caps inputs at INPUT_MAX_SIZE = 64 KiB, below the 2 MiB rx buffer, so it cannot reach Dave. SendCmioResponse (identical in released and regenerated) checks the size before writing imcyclemax or the revert root hash, as send-cmio-response.cpp does. inputLength goes through SafeCast.toUint32. (4) The Lua referee model (prt.lua validate_state_transition_response, mirrored in doc/README.md and in vg.lua) and the off-chain check prt-ethereum.verify_transition pass root_hash_before as the revert root hash. (5) The honest player (prt.lua prove_state_transition) logs delivery with pair.revert_root_hash. That value is set to machine:get_root_hash() when a pair is created and after each accepted input. A rejection reverts the pair and asserts the root equals revert_root_hash. A stopped input (halt, exception, imcyclemax) leaves it stale, but every later delivery is then a no-op. Native machine::send_cmio_response also refuses a revert root hash that differs from get_root_hash() when the delivery applies. The prt-ethereum.transition_proof encoding (8-byte big-endian length, input bytes, cmio log, step log, then the reset log) matches what CartesiStateTransition and AccessLogs consume. The JSON-RPC client replaces an oversized payload with 2 MiB+1 zero bytes, which changes nothing because the delivery is a no-op either way. Rejection timing: imcyclemax = delivery mcycle + 2^48 - 1, so a rejecting instruction always completes before the last mcycle of its window, and its closing reset reverts inside the window. No input boundary can be a rejecting state that has not been reverted.
evidence: Ran /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-machine-emulator/549e7dd9-06ba-5ccf-8b17-f8cce9526655/scratchpad/campaign/r1/A4/a4-revert.lua (Lua API plus the shared EVM StepVerifier on the regenerated step, configuration baremetal-template). Accepted input 'AAAA' gives root1. Input 'R' rejects, and the rejecting machine's revert root hash equals root1. step+reset of the rejecting mcycle on the EVM returns root1; the native machine stays at its content hash, as R6 requires. Delivering 'BBBBBBBB' from root1 with revert root1 gives sendCmioResponseThenStep(EVM) == native, and the recorded revert root hash == root1. An oversized input (2 MiB+1) is a no-op natively and EVM == native. Delivery at a rejected yield and at a halt is a no-op. All checks pass.
not_covered: No end-to-end test through a deployed Dave CartesiStateTransition (chain harness) for delivery after a rejection. Checked through the StepVerifier harness wrapper, which passes root as the revert root hash the same way, and by reading the code.
Gas and calldata size of a 64 KiB-input delivery proof against the real per-transaction limits (A3/R12). The EVM harness disables the limits.
The Rust or other node components of Dave that build proofs (validator nodes are out of scope).
Rejection at saturated mcycle (imcyclemax saturating at UINT64_MAX), beyond the reasoning that mcycle overflow is a fixed point.
A uarch-level claim built with collect_uarch_cycle_root_hashes for the rejecting period (revert_uarch_tail path) under every bundle height. That belongs to R6 rather than A4.
Stored-player restart paths (revert_interrupted_input, agreed.revert) and whether revert_root_hash survives every reload, beyond reading that pairs set it from get_root_hash() on creation.
Whether the player's read_input and the bridge's self.inputs could disagree for a slot after a chain reorganization within the confirmation policy.
